cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. In this role you will plan, design and communicate sequence of operations; CNC Programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. Setup, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of Component's Group products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of the Component's Group technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies. Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. In addition, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Assist in the development and design of new products by providing advice on and determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and will advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Provide manufacturing input and provide a smooth transition into efficient production. Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Setup, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or the equivalent in experience
Knowledge of CAD/CAM and a strong knowledge of CNC Programming
A full understanding of manufacturing process and the ability to fully apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing
4 - 5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates to perform at this level
Preferred Requirements
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates to perform at this level
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.

cond_0009.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at [Location masked]. In this role, you will work with others to plan, design, and communicate sequences of operations — including CNC programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures, plant layout, and equipment utilization or modification — to support the total manufacturing process. You will also help set up, prove out, and train personnel on CNC machines, and work with the team to identify and implement design and process improvements for more effective manufacturing.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules by working with others to develop and design methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures, and equipment modifications in line with sound engineering principles, policies, and practices.
Help ensure efficient plant layout, material flow, and machine and labor utilization by coordinating the planning of factory machinery layout, manufacturing operation sequences, and procedures for fabrication, assembly, and testing of [Product name masked] products.
Coordinate plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, and work with others to devise holding mechanisms and tooling to support product manufacture.
Work alongside the team to research newer technologies and develop proposals for automation or redesign of methods, tooling, and machine attachments to reduce manufacturing costs and improve efficiencies.
Prepare cost estimates for transitioning from current to new methods and share estimated cost savings resulting from such changes.
Help inform make-or-buy decisions based on the group's technical capabilities, equipment, labor, and available capital.
Support production of quality parts and components by helping verify machine, equipment, and tool efficiency and performance. Coordinate investigation and corrective action for problems or deficiencies.
Help ensure timely introduction of new products and methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through operation sheets, manufacturing database entries (ERP routings, setup sheet info, AutoDesk/AutoCAD), visual aids, and CNC programs as needed.
Work with the team to evaluate schedule milestones in early design and prototype phases, help monitor costs, and ensure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Support new product development by sharing input on producibility of design concepts and specification requirements that best use existing equipment and manufacturing techniques. Keep design engineers informed of manufacturing limitations and opportunities, and share with Manufacturing Engineering Management any new capabilities that competitive designs may require.
Help ensure a smooth transition into efficient production by contributing manufacturing input throughout the development process.
Program CNC machines using CAD/CAM, conversational, or manual methods. Set up, prove out, and help optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on CNC machine programming and setup.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong knowledge of CNC programming
Knowledge of CAD/CAM
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and ability to apply manufacturing theories and concepts
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming, machining, or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates
Preferred Requirements
Experience with ERP systems (routings, setup sheets)
Familiarity with AutoDesk/AutoCAD
Experience with CAD/CAM-based CNC programming methods

In this role you will plan, design and communicate sequence of operations; CNC Programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. You will regularly set up, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines, and stay in close contact with production and design teams to investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0033.responsibilities: Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and actively initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies, connecting with the relevant teams early to resolve issues. Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Assist in the development and design of new products by providing advice on and determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will regularly communicate with design engineers about both manufacturing limitations and opportunities, and will keep Manufacturing Engineering Management informed of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Provide manufacturing input and provide a smooth transition into efficient production. Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Set up, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines, and be available to answer questions and walk colleagues through procedures as needed.
cond_0033.requirements: A Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline or the equivalent in experience. Knowledge of CAD/CAM and a strong knowledge of CNC Programming are necessary. A full understanding of manufacturing process and the ability to fully apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing is essential. Typically, the degreed incumbent would require 4 - 5 years directly related experience to perform at this level. Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience would be required for non-degreed employees to perform at this level.

cond_0271.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. In this role you will plan, design and communicate sequence of operations; CNC Programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. Setup, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0271.responsibilities: Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of Component's Group products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of the Component's Group technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies. Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. In addition, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Assist in the development and design of new products by providing advice on and determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and will advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Provide manufacturing input and provide a smooth transition into efficient production. Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Setup, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0271.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or the equivalent in experience
Knowledge of CAD/CAM and a strong knowledge of CNC Programming
A full understanding of manufacturing process and the ability to fully apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing
4 - 5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates to perform at this level
Preferred Requirements
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates to perform at this level

cond_0363.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at our [Location masked] facility. In this role you will plan, design and communicate sequence of operations; CNC Programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. Setup, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0363.responsibilities: Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of Component's Group products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of the Component's Group technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies. Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. In addition, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Assist in the development and design of new products by providing advice on and determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and will advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Provide manufacturing input and provide a smooth transition into efficient production. Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Setup, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.

cond_0371.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. In this role you will plan, design and communicate sequence of operations; CNC Programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. Setup, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0371.responsibilities: Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of Component's Group products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of the Component's Group technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies. Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. In addition, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Assist in the development and design of new products by providing advice on and determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and will advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Provide manufacturing input and provide a smooth transition into efficient production. Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Setup, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0371.requirements: Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred, or equivalent demonstrated expertise through experience. Deep knowledge of CAD/CAM and strong command of CNC Programming are necessary. A thorough, advanced understanding of manufacturing process and the proven ability to fully apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing is essential. Degreed candidates are expected to bring a minimum of 5 years of directly related experience to perform at this level. Non-degreed candidates must have at least ten years of substantial, varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience to perform at this level.

Help ensure efficient plant layout, material flow, and machine and labor utilization by coordinating the planning of factory machinery layout, manufacturing operation sequences, and procedures for fabrication, assembly, and testing of [Product name masked] products.
Coordinate plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, and work with others to devise holding mechanisms and tooling to support product manufacture.
Work alongside the team to research newer technologies and develop proposals for automation or redesign of methods, tooling, and machine attachments to reduce manufacturing costs and improve efficiencies.
Prepare cost estimates for transitioning from current to new methods and share estimated cost savings resulting from such changes.
Help inform make-or-buy decisions based on the group's technical capabilities, equipment, labor, and available capital.
Support production of quality parts and components by helping verify machine, equipment, and tool efficiency and performance. Coordinate investigation and corrective action for problems or deficiencies.
Help ensure timely introduction of new products and methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through operation sheets, manufacturing database entries (ERP routings, setup sheet info, AutoDesk/AutoCAD), visual aids, and CNC programs as needed.
Work with the team to evaluate schedule milestones in early design and prototype phases, help monitor costs, and ensure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Support new product development by sharing input on producibility of design concepts and specification requirements that best use existing equipment and manufacturing techniques. Keep design engineers informed of manufacturing limitations and opportunities, and share with Manufacturing Engineering Management any new capabilities that competitive designs may require.
Help ensure a smooth transition into efficient production by contributing manufacturing input throughout the development process.
Program CNC machines using CAD/CAM, conversational, or manual methods. Set up, prove out, and help optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on CNC machine programming and setup.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong knowledge of CNC programming
Knowledge of CAD/CAM
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and ability to apply manufacturing theories and concepts
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming, machining, or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates
Preferred Requirements
Experience with ERP systems (routings, setup sheets)
Familiarity with AutoDesk/AutoCAD
Experience with CAD/CAM-based CNC programming methods

Determine the most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by directing the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of [Company name masked] products.
Execute plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture.
Deliver cost reductions and efficiency gains through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost.
Prepare cost estimates involved in changing from present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes.
Determine critical make or buy decisions on the basis of technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital.
Ensure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies.
Own timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required.
Evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and ensure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Lead input on new product development by determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. Inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory.
Deliver manufacturing input and ensure a smooth transition into efficient production.
Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Set up, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0404.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Strong knowledge of CNC Programming and knowledge of CAD/CAM.
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and the ability to apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing.
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates.
Preferred Requirements
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience (applicable for non-degreed candidates).

cond_0404.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

cond_0405.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at [Location masked]. In this role, you will work with others to plan, design, and communicate sequences of operations — including CNC programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures, plant layout, and equipment utilization or modification — to support the total manufacturing process. You will also help set up, prove out, and train personnel on CNC machines, and work with the team to identify and implement design and process improvements for more effective manufacturing.
cond_0405.responsibilities:
Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules by working with others to develop and design methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures, and equipment modifications in line with sound engineering principles, policies, and practices.
Help ensure efficient plant layout, material flow, and machine and labor utilization by coordinating the planning of factory machinery layout, manufacturing operation sequences, and procedures for fabrication, assembly, and testing of [Product name masked] products.
Coordinate plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, and work with others to devise holding mechanisms and tooling to support product manufacture.
Work alongside the team to research newer technologies and develop proposals for automation or redesign of methods, tooling, and machine attachments to reduce manufacturing costs and improve efficiencies.
Prepare cost estimates for transitioning from current to new methods and share estimated cost savings resulting from such changes.
Help inform make-or-buy decisions based on the group's technical capabilities, equipment, labor, and available capital.
Support production of quality parts and components by helping verify machine, equipment, and tool efficiency and performance. Coordinate investigation and corrective action for problems or deficiencies.
Help ensure timely introduction of new products and methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through operation sheets, manufacturing database entries (ERP routings, setup sheet info, AutoDesk/AutoCAD), visual aids, and CNC programs as needed.
Work with the team to evaluate schedule milestones in early design and prototype phases, help monitor costs, and ensure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Support new product development by sharing input on producibility of design concepts and specification requirements that best use existing equipment and manufacturing techniques. Keep design engineers informed of manufacturing limitations and opportunities, and share with Manufacturing Engineering Management any new capabilities that competitive designs may require.
Help ensure a smooth transition into efficient production by contributing manufacturing input throughout the development process.
Program CNC machines using CAD/CAM, conversational, or manual methods. Set up, prove out, and help optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on CNC machine programming and setup.

Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong knowledge of CNC programming
Knowledge of CAD/CAM
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and ability to apply manufacturing theories and concepts
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming, machining, or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates

Experience with ERP systems (routings, setup sheets)
Familiarity with AutoDesk/AutoCAD
Experience with CAD/CAM-based CNC programming methods

You will set up, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines, and lead the investigation and implementation of design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0413.responsibilities: Drive production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Determine the most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by directing the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of [Company name masked] products. Prepare and execute plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Deliver cost reductions and efficiency gains through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Ensure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies. Ensure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. In addition, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and ensure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Lead input into the development and design of new products by determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and will advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Deliver manufacturing input and own a smooth transition into efficient production. Drive production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Set up, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0413.requirements: A Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline or the equivalent in experience. Knowledge of CAD/CAM and a strong knowledge of CNC Programming are necessary. A full understanding of manufacturing process and the ability to fully apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing is essential. Typically, the degreed incumbent would require 4 - 5 years directly related experience to perform at this level. Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience would be required for non-degreed employees to perform at this level.
cond_0413.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0413.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

Determine the most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by directing the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of [Company name masked] products.
Execute plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture.
Deliver cost reductions and efficiency gains through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost.
Prepare cost estimates involved in changing from present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes.
Determine critical make or buy decisions on the basis of technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital.
Ensure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies.
Own timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required.
Evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and ensure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Lead input on new product development by determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. Inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory.
Deliver manufacturing input and ensure a smooth transition into efficient production.
Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Set up, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0422.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Strong knowledge of CNC Programming and knowledge of CAD/CAM.
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and the ability to apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing.
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates.
Preferred Requirements
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience (applicable for non-degreed candidates).
cond_0422.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

cond_0423.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at [Location masked]. In this role, you will work with others to plan, design, and communicate sequences of operations — including CNC programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures, plant layout, and equipment utilization or modification — to support the total manufacturing process. You will also help set up, prove out, and train personnel on CNC machines, and work with the team to identify and implement design and process improvements for more effective manufacturing.
cond_0423.responsibilities:
Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules by working with others to develop and design methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures, and equipment modifications in line with sound engineering principles, policies, and practices.
Help ensure efficient plant layout, material flow, and machine and labor utilization by coordinating the planning of factory machinery layout, manufacturing operation sequences, and procedures for fabrication, assembly, and testing of [Product name masked] products.
Coordinate plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, and work with others to devise holding mechanisms and tooling to support product manufacture.
Work alongside the team to research newer technologies and develop proposals for automation or redesign of methods, tooling, and machine attachments to reduce manufacturing costs and improve efficiencies.
Prepare cost estimates for transitioning from current to new methods and share estimated cost savings resulting from such changes.
Help inform make-or-buy decisions based on the group's technical capabilities, equipment, labor, and available capital.
Support production of quality parts and components by helping verify machine, equipment, and tool efficiency and performance. Coordinate investigation and corrective action for problems or deficiencies.
Help ensure timely introduction of new products and methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through operation sheets, manufacturing database entries (ERP routings, setup sheet info, AutoDesk/AutoCAD), visual aids, and CNC programs as needed.
Work with the team to evaluate schedule milestones in early design and prototype phases, help monitor costs, and ensure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Support new product development by sharing input on producibility of design concepts and specification requirements that best use existing equipment and manufacturing techniques. Keep design engineers informed of manufacturing limitations and opportunities, and share with Manufacturing Engineering Management any new capabilities that competitive designs may require.
Help ensure a smooth transition into efficient production by contributing manufacturing input throughout the development process.
Program CNC machines using CAD/CAM, conversational, or manual methods. Set up, prove out, and help optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on CNC machine programming and setup.
cond_0423.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong knowledge of CNC programming
Knowledge of CAD/CAM
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and ability to apply manufacturing theories and concepts
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming, machining, or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates
Preferred Requirements
Experience with ERP systems (routings, setup sheets)
Familiarity with AutoDesk/AutoCAD
Experience with CAD/CAM-based CNC programming methods

Stay in regular contact with production and planning teams to assure the most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for fabrication, assembly and/or test of products.
Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture.
Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost.
Prepare cost estimates involved in changing from present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes.
Recommend or determine critical make or buy decisions on the basis of technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital.
Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies.
Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing database entries (ERP routings, setup sheet info., AutoDesk/AutoCAD), visual aids and CNC programs as required.
Evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Actively contribute to new product development by advising design engineers on manufacturing limitations and opportunities; walk stakeholders through producibility of design concepts and specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques.
Keep Manufacturing Engineering Management informed of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory.
Provide manufacturing input and support a smooth transition into efficient production.
Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, conversational or manual methods. Set up, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines, and actively share knowledge across the team on an ongoing basis.
cond_0456.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Strong knowledge of CNC programming and CAD/CAM.
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and the ability to apply manufacturing theories and concepts.
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates.
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with ERP routing systems and setup documentation.
Familiarity with AutoDesk/AutoCAD or similar drafting tools.
Background in automation proposals or advanced manufacturing technologies.

cond_0473.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer for our [Location masked] facility. In this role you will plan, design and communicate sequence of operations; CNC Programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. Setup, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience with CNC programming, process development, and hands-on machining.
cond_0473.responsibilities: Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of Component's Group products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of the Component's Group technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies. Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. In addition, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Assist in the development and design of new products by providing advice on and determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and will advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Provide manufacturing input and provide a smooth transition into efficient production. Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Setup, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.

cond_0474.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer for our [Location masked] facility. In this role you will plan, design, and communicate sequence of operations; CNC programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. You will set up, prove-out, and train personnel on CNC machines, and regularly connect with production and design teams to investigate, identify, and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost-effective manufacturing.
cond_0474.responsibilities:
Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices.
Stay in regular contact with production and planning teams to assure the most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for fabrication, assembly and/or test of products.
Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture.
Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost.
Prepare cost estimates involved in changing from present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes.
Recommend or determine critical make or buy decisions on the basis of technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital.
Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies.
Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing database entries (ERP routings, setup sheet info., AutoDesk/AutoCAD), visual aids and CNC programs as required.
Evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Actively contribute to new product development by advising design engineers on manufacturing limitations and opportunities; walk stakeholders through producibility of design concepts and specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques.
Keep Manufacturing Engineering Management informed of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory.
Provide manufacturing input and support a smooth transition into efficient production.
Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, conversational or manual methods. Set up, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines, and actively share knowledge across the team on an ongoing basis.
cond_0474.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Strong knowledge of CNC programming and CAD/CAM.
Full understanding of manufacturing processes and the ability to apply manufacturing theories and concepts.
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates.
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with ERP routing systems and setup documentation.
Familiarity with AutoDesk/AutoCAD or similar drafting tools.
Background in automation proposals or advanced manufacturing technologies.

Setup, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0505.responsibilities: Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of Component's Group products. Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture. Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Also, efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost. Prepare cost estimates involved in the changing from the present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes. Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of the Component's Group technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital. Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies. Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by communicating and documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing data base entries (ERP (Routings), (Setup sheet info.), (AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs if required. In addition, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer is expected to evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture. Assist in the development and design of new products by providing advice on and determining the producibility of design concepts and the specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. In this capacity, the Senior Manufacturing Engineer will inform design engineers of both manufacturing limitations and opportunities and will advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory. Provide manufacturing input and provide a smooth transition into efficient production. Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the introduction of new technologies, the development and design of methods, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices. Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, Conversational or manual methods. Setup, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines. Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0505.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or the equivalent in experience
Knowledge of CAD/CAM and a strong knowledge of CNC Programming
A full understanding of manufacturing process and the ability to fully apply the theories and concepts of manufacturing
4 - 5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates to perform at this level
Preferred Requirements
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates to perform at this level
cond_0505.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0505.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

cond_0601.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer for our [Location masked] facility. In this role you will plan, design and document sequence of operations; CNC Programming, required tooling, jigs and fixtures; layout of plant; and necessary equipment utilization and/or modification to machine, form, weld, assemble, test, package and transport component parts and/or final products in support of the total manufacturing process. Setup, prove-out and train personnel on CNC machines. Investigate, identify and implement design and process improvements for better and more cost effective manufacturing.
cond_0601.responsibilities:
Support production activities to achieve shipment schedules through the development and design of methods, processes, specifications, tooling, jigs, fixtures and/or equipment modification in conformance with basic and sound engineering principles, policies and practices.
Assure most efficient, economic and productive plant layout, material flow and machine and labor utilization by planning the layout of factory machinery, the sequence of manufacturing operations and the specific procedures required for the fabrication, assembly and/or test of [Product name masked] products.
Prepare and carry out plans to change part or material specifications, manufacturing methods, material or product routing, etc. And/or devise holding mechanisms and required tooling to facilitate product manufacture.
Reduce the cost to manufacture products and increase current efficiencies through research of newer or advanced technologies and development of proposals for automation and/or the redesign of methods, tooling, machine attachments, etc. Efficient methodizing will reduce direct labor and, therefore, product cost.
Prepare cost estimates involved in changing from present to new methods and estimate cost savings as the result of such changes.
Recommend or determine the critical make or buy decisions on the basis of technical capabilities, equipment, labor and available capital.
Assure production of quality parts, components and products by verifying machine, equipment and tool efficiency and performance. Investigate and initiate corrective action of problems or deficiencies.
Assure timely introduction of new products and/or methods by documenting required production operations through the preparation of operation sheets, manufacturing database entries (ERP routings, setup sheet info., AutoDesk/AutoCad), visual aids and CNC programs as required.
Evaluate schedule milestones in early phases of design and prototype work, monitor costs, and assure quality and serviceability are considered during design and manufacture.
Contribute manufacturing input to new product development by assessing the producibility of design concepts and specification requirements that best utilize existing equipment, technologies and manufacturing techniques. Inform design engineers of manufacturing limitations and opportunities, and advise Manufacturing Engineering Management of new capabilities that competitive designs will require for the factory.
Provide manufacturing input and support a smooth transition into efficient production.
Program CNC machines through CAD/CAM, conversational or manual methods. Setup, prove-out, and optimize part manufacturing on CNC machines.
Train other manufacturing personnel on programming and setup of CNC machines.
cond_0601.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong knowledge of CNC Programming and CAD/CAM
Full understanding of manufacturing processes with the ability to apply manufacturing theories and concepts
4–5 Years of directly related experience for degreed candidates
Ten years of varied machine shop, tool making, CNC programming and machining or other specialized manufacturing experience for non-degreed candidates
Preferred Requirements
Experience with ERP routing systems and manufacturing database tools (e.g., AutoDesk/AutoCad)
Familiarity with automation proposals and advanced manufacturing technologies
